notes: DRAFT from the bible v1.0 section 12. Relations between the PLAYER and each monster group, tracked separately per group. The group-to-group table is flavour for event and quest writers only: it drives no hierarchy and no autonomous faction war (Canon 4d). The bible Subjugated and At-war group states are not imported (Canon 4d, proposal M4). Standing moves only through quests, flags and the player's own actions, never because the player was defeated.

playerStates.name: Hostile
playerStates.text: Attacks on sight or actively obstructs the player.

playerStates.name: Wary
playerStates.text: Avoids open conflict but distrusts outsiders.

playerStates.name: Neutral
playerStates.text: Trades or interacts under normal rules.

playerStates.name: Friendly
playerStates.text: Offers aid, information or safe passage.

playerStates.name: Allied
playerStates.text: Shares resources, missions and coordinated support.

groups.note: Allies: orcs, ogres, mercenary groups. Tensions: hobgoblin states, nearby settlements.
Allies: ogres, trolls, some beast clans. Tensions: dragons, giants, rival orc clans.
Allies: wyverns, drakes, selected fae courts. Tensions: giants, titans, rival dragon houses.
Allies: vampires, wraiths, necromantic factions. Tensions: celestials, exorcists, living kingdoms.
Allies: corrupted undead, cults, void agents. Tensions: celestials, cursebreakers, rival demon courts.
Allies: arachnids, some plant monsters. Tensions: beasts, farmers, mining settlements.
Allies: elementals, construct guilds. Tensions: demons, thieves, incompetent commands.
Allies: plant monsters, spirits, conservationists. Tensions: demons, exploitative hunters, oath-breakers.
Allies: sea serpents, hydras, coastal factions. Tensions: maritime empires, pollution, rival sea kings.
Allies: other void entities, cults, unstable constructs. Tensions: celestial orders, reality wardens, world defenders.

exampleRule: A player may be allied with an Orc clan while an Orc clan confederation remains hostile, or trusted by a Vampire house while the Exorcists Order distrusts them (per-faction and per-guild tracking).
